heading: THE KENSHO REVOLUTION: Inside the AI-Driven 'eMAXIS Neo' Series Upending the Japanese Mutual Fund Market
story:
By The VILFIN TV Financial Desk | Exclusive Report

The traditional index fund is facing an existential crisis. For decades, passive investing meant simply tracking companies based on their market capitalization—buying the biggest companies and ignoring the underlying narrative. But as we navigate 2026, Mitsubishi UFJ Asset Management’s eMAXIS Neo series has officially proven that passive investing no longer needs to be "dumb."

Powered by S&P Kensho's Natural Language Processing (NLP) AI, the eMAXIS Neo series has stripped the steering wheel from human stock-pickers and legacy algorithms. Kensho’s AI acts as a tireless, omniscient analyst, reading millions of pages of regulatory filings, annual reports, and earnings transcripts. If an old-school legacy manufacturer suddenly dedicates a massive portion of its R&D to robotics or clean energy, the AI detects the shift in the text and instantly flags the stock for inclusion during its semi-annual rebalance.

The result? A suite of 14 highly concentrated, hyper-growth thematic funds that have delivered some of the most astronomical—and volatile—returns in the Japanese retail market. In this VILFIN TV Exclusive, we break down the performance, the underlying stock engines, and the future outlook for every single fund in the eMAXIS Neo ecosystem.

The Space & Skies Frontier: Leaving Earth Behind

The commercialization of orbit is no longer a billionaire’s vanity project; it is the backbone of modern global telecommunications and defense.
